en.headline: Police hold 19 after West Kowloon illegal-work operation
en.dek: Officers said Monday's joint sweep of restaurants, massage shops and buildings led to 19 arrests, including two wanted men.
body: West Kowloon police and officers from related departments carried out a joint operation against illegal employment on Monday, police said, searching restaurants, massage shops and buildings across the district.

The operation, coded POWERPLAYER and SAHARA, involved the West Kowloon regional crime unit, the regional tactical unit, the Yau Tsim anti-triad team, the Tsim Sha Tsui special duty squad and district operational units, according to police.

Police said 19 people aged 19 to 57 were arrested: nine non-ethnic-Chinese men, four non-ethnic-Chinese women, four foreign women, one local man and one mainland woman. They are accused of breaching conditions of stay, illegal entry, overstaying, employing a person not lawfully employable, and trafficking in dangerous drugs. Two of the men were wanted persons.
All those arrested were being detained for further inquiries, police said. None has been charged in court in connection with the operation.

zh.headline: 西九龍反黑工行動拘19人 包括兩名通緝男子
zh.dek: 警方稱周一聯同相關部門突擊搜查食肆、按摩店及大廈，拘捕19人，其中兩名男子是通緝人士。
body: 警方表示，西九龍總區刑事部、機動部隊、油尖警區反三合會行動組、尖沙咀分區特遣隊及各警區行動部，周一聯同相關部門在西九龍展開反非法勞工行動，突擊搜查食肆、按摩店及大廈。
行動代號為「權能者」及「撒哈拉」。警方稱，人員搜查多個地點，對象包括食肆、按摩店及樓宇。
警方表示，行動拘捕19人，年齡介乎19至57歲，包括9名非華裔男子、4名非華裔女子、4名外籍女子、1名本地男子及1名內地女子。
他們涉嫌違反逗留條件、非法入境、逾期居留、僱用不可合法受僱的人，以及販運危險藥物，其中兩名男子是通緝人士。警方稱所有被捕人正被扣留調查，案件尚未在法庭提控。
